thread:
harper: Spotted a jittery quota spike on console during last canary. looks like keepalive counts drift when proxy strips context headers mid-retry.
sujay: I noticed that too. two keepalive hits for same reconnect, but runtime logs only show one resume.
nina: hypothesis: proxy retries are firing internal keepalive telemetry, but when it retries it loses X-Request-Context so collector treats it as fresh flow.
harper: minimal repro: open SSE, force proxy reconnect loop with intermittent 502, proxy emits preflight keepalive without context, then runtime resume emits keepalive with flow_id -> double.
oliver: short-term: add header X-Keepalive-Hint: proxy on retry and have collector treat hint events as "incomplete" and buffer aggregation for 350ms to allow resume to attach flow_id.
sujay: agree. also add metric tag keepalive_hint=true so console can filter them out of alerts.
nina: console UX: suggest suppressing route alerts for bursts dominated (>80%) by keepalive_hint events for 10m after canary rollouts. add banner: "Likely probe/retry noise; suppressed."
deploy-bot: canary deploy started for oliver/keepalive-hint-buffer (build 6542).
oliver: canary metrics: duplicate keepalive down ~89%, alert churn reduced. promoting after 25m.
console-bot: alert-mute applied to quota-edge-canary until backfill completes.
harper: follow-ups: PR for header+buffer, console suppression rule, and a backfill to reclassify affected windows. I'll file tickets.
sujay: long-term: require proxies to propagate original_request_context on retries. opened ticket T-3001.
harper: thanks team, closing thread once backfill finishes.
